one_line: Feudatory-generals of the Yadavas of Devagiri, leading frontier campaigns in Lata, Karnataka and Goa under Singhana II.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, athletic and battle-hardened, slightly taller than average
appearance.face: oval faces with sharp jawlines, wheatish Deccan complexions; Kholeshvara has a narrow straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache and calm, calculating eyes; Bichana has a broader nose, thicker moustache and intense, confident eyes; default expression for both is composed, alert focus.
appearance.hair: both with thick, black hair; Kholeshvara’s hair pulled back into a short, neat top-knot under a dark indigo cloth turban wrapped low and tight with a simple bronze front clasp; Bichana’s hair also in a compact top-knot but under a muted maroon cloth turban with a small copper disc ornament slightly off-centre.
appearance.costume: They wear coordinated but distinct late-12th–early-13th century Deccan warrior outfits: Kholeshvara has a long-sleeved cotton tunic (angarkha-style wrap) in deep indigo, tied on the right, reaching mid-thigh, worn over a quilted, dull-bronze hued cotton-padded vest shaped like a simple chahar-aina without plates, and over this a sleeveless, reddish-brown leather jerkin with subtle darker stitching lines along the edges; his lower body is in cream cotton churidar-style fitted trousers gathered at the ankles, tucked into mid-calf height brown leather boots with simple lacing and no metal trim; at the waist a broad natural-tan leather belt with a bronze buckle supports a fabric kamarband sash in faded saffron wrapped twice and knotted on the left, from which hangs a small rectangular leather document pouch and a ring of two bronze keys; his forearms are covered by quilted dark-brown fabric bracers, and he wears modest bronze stud earrings and a thin bronze neck torque, with no ostentatious jewellery. Bichana wears a similar angarkha tunic in warm maroon, wrapped left over right, under a quilted, matte dark-grey padded vest suggesting simple lamellar padding, and over it a sleeveless, olive-brown leather jerkin with visible stitched panels; his trousers are pale sand-coloured cotton, slightly looser but gathered at the ankle, tucked into slightly heavier brown leather boots reinforced with an extra stitched layer over the instep; his waist has a broad darker-brown leather belt with two small bronze rings, supporting a deep-olive cloth kamarband sash knotted on the right, from which hangs a small rolled-map case and a narrow dagger sheath; his forearms have dark-grey fabric bracers, and he wears small copper hoop earrings and a simple black thread amulet around the neck; both have modest, era-accurate metal finger rings but nothing lavish, projecting administrative generals rather than kings.
appearance.signature: Kholeshvara carries a single long straight iron sword with a simple bronze cross-guard and undecorated wooden grip, its plain leather scabbard hanging on his left side, and in his left hand he often holds a rolled palm-leaf dispatch tied with a thin red cord; Bichana carries a slightly shorter, broader-bladed iron sword with a rounded bronze guard and wooden grip, its scabbard slung on his left, and he often holds a small wooden campaign map board—a flat, rectangular plank with faintly carved route lines—under his right arm.

ref_desc: Kholeshvara and Bichana are wheatish-complexioned Deccan generals with black hair in top-knots under indigo and maroon turbans, sharp moustached faces, indigo and maroon angarkha tunics over padded vests and leather jerkins, cream and sand trousers, brown boots, bronze/copper ornaments, and plain iron swords with leather scabbards plus a dispatch scroll and wooden map board in a deep indigo, maroon, cream, brown leather and bronze palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Kholeshvara and Bichana standing side by side as Deccan feudatory-generals: both in their early 30s, athletic, wheatish complexions, sharp oval faces with moustaches, alert and composed. Kholeshvara is slightly taller, with thick black hair in a neat top-knot under a low-wrapped dark indigo cloth turban with a simple bronze clasp, calm calculating eyes, wearing a deep indigo long-sleeved wrap tunic mid-thigh over a dull-bronze quilted padded vest, and a sleeveless reddish-brown leather jerkin with subtle stitched edges. His cream fitted churidar trousers are tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots, and his waist has a broad tan leather belt with bronze buckle and a faded saffron sash wrapped twice, with a small rectangular leather document pouch and two bronze keys hanging. He has dark-brown quilted fabric bracers, modest bronze stud earrings and a thin bronze neck torque, plus simple rings. His signature long straight iron sword with bronze cross-guard and plain wooden grip hangs in a brown leather scabbard at his left hip, and he holds a rolled palm-leaf dispatch tied with a red cord in his left hand. Bichana stands beside him with equally thick black hair in a compact top-knot under a muted maroon turban with a small copper disc ornament, intense confident eyes, wearing a maroon wrap tunic over a dark-grey quilted padded vest and an olive-brown sleeveless leather jerkin. His pale sand-coloured cotton trousers are slightly looser, tucked into heavier brown leather boots with extra stitched reinforcement. A broad darker-brown leather belt and deep-olive sash at his waist carry a small rolled-map case and a narrow dagger sheath. He wears dark-grey fabric bracers, small copper hoop earrings and a simple black thread amulet, plus modest rings. His slightly shorter, broader iron sword with rounded bronze guard hangs on his left in a leather scabbard, and he supports a flat rectangular wooden campaign map board carved with faint route lines under his right arm. Use a palette dominated by deep indigo, maroon, cream, brown leather tones and warm bronze/copper metals, with clear view of faces, hair, costumes head-to-toe, swords, scroll and map board for consistent redrawing.
